durer-anunciacao.title: The Annunciation
durer-anunciacao.alt: Black-and-white woodcut: in a large vaulted hall, the angel and Mary kneel on opposite sides; above, a dove.
durer-anunciacao.caption: Albrecht Dürer, The Annunciation, from the series The Life of the Virgin, 1511.

durer-apresentacao-jesus.title: The Presentation of Christ in the Temple
durer-apresentacao-jesus.alt: Black-and-white woodcut: in a large hall with columns, a woman kneels beside an altar table, with a priest and other people around.
durer-apresentacao-jesus.caption: Albrecht Dürer, The Presentation of Christ in the Temple, from the series The Life of the Virgin, about 1505.

durer-apresentacao-maria.title: The Presentation of the Virgin in the Temple
durer-apresentacao-maria.alt: Black-and-white woodcut: in a courtyard with columns and arches, a child before priests at the entrance of the temple, with many faithful in the foreground.
durer-apresentacao-maria.caption: Albrecht Dürer, The Presentation of the Virgin in the Temple, from the series The Life of the Virgin, about 1503.

durer-assuncao-coroacao.title: The Assumption and Coronation of the Virgin
durer-assuncao-coroacao.alt: Black-and-white woodcut: Mary is crowned among clouds by two figures, with a dove; below, apostles around an open tomb.
durer-assuncao-coroacao.caption: Albrecht Dürer, The Assumption and Coronation of the Virgin, from the series The Life of the Virgin, 1510.

durer-circuncisao.title: The Circumcision
durer-circuncisao.alt: Black-and-white woodcut: inside a temple, a priest and many faithful gathered around the Child; Mary among them.
durer-circuncisao.caption: Albrecht Dürer, The Circumcision, from the series The Life of the Virgin, about 1504.

durer-despedida.title: Christ Taking Leave of His Mother
durer-despedida.alt: Black-and-white woodcut: outdoors, by a fence and a tree, a kneeling woman, supported by others, before Christ standing.
durer-despedida.caption: Albrecht Dürer, Christ Taking Leave of His Mother, from the series The Life of the Virgin, 1511.

durer-desposorios.title: The Betrothal of the Virgin
durer-desposorios.alt: Black-and-white woodcut: beneath a large arch, a priest joins the hands of a couple before witnesses.
durer-desposorios.caption: Albrecht Dürer, The Betrothal of the Virgin, from the series The Life of the Virgin, about 1504.

durer-dormicao.title: The Death of the Virgin
durer-dormicao.alt: Black-and-white woodcut: Mary lying in a canopy bed, surrounded by the apostles, one of them in the foreground with a staff.
durer-dormicao.caption: Albrecht Dürer, The Death of the Virgin, from the series The Life of the Virgin, 1511.

durer-egito-sagrada-familia.title: The Holy Family in Egypt
durer-egito-sagrada-familia.alt: Black-and-white woodcut: in front of houses, Mary sits with the Child and Joseph works wood; little angels gather wood chips.
durer-egito-sagrada-familia.caption: Albrecht Dürer, The Holy Family in Egypt, from the series The Life of the Virgin, 1511.

durer-entre-doutores.title: Christ among the Doctors
durer-entre-doutores.alt: Black-and-white woodcut: the young Jesus before a group of doctors, in a space of arches and columns; Mary and Joseph on the left.
durer-entre-doutores.caption: Albrecht Dürer, Christ among the Doctors, from the series The Life of the Virgin, 1511.

durer-fuga-egito.title: The Flight into Egypt
durer-fuga-egito.alt: Black-and-white woodcut: Mary, riding a donkey with the Child, and Joseph in front walk through a wood with a palm tree.
durer-fuga-egito.caption: Albrecht Dürer, The Flight into Egypt, from the series The Life of the Virgin, 1511.

durer-glorificacao.title: The Glorification of the Virgin
durer-glorificacao.alt: Black-and-white woodcut with Latin text below: a large hall of arches and columns with many figures gathered around Mary.
durer-glorificacao.caption: Albrecht Dürer, The Glorification of the Virgin, from the series The Life of the Virgin, 1511.

durer-joaquim-anjo.title: Joachim and the Angel
durer-joaquim-anjo.alt: Black-and-white woodcut: a man kneeling in a landscape with trees and a flock looks up to where an angel with large wings descends among the branches; in the background, shepherds and a lake.
durer-joaquim-anjo.caption: Albrecht Dürer, Joachim and the Angel, from the series The Life of the Virgin, about 1504.

durer-madona-crescente.title: The Madonna on the Crescent Moon, frontispiece
durer-madona-crescente.alt: Black-and-white woodcut: the Virgin with the Child seated on a crescent moon, in a halo of rays; Latin text at the top.
durer-madona-crescente.caption: Albrecht Dürer, The Madonna on the Crescent Moon, frontispiece, from the series The Life of the Virgin, about 1511.

durer-magos.title: The Adoration of the Magi
durer-magos.alt: Black-and-white woodcut: under a wooden roof, Mary with the Child receives men kneeling in the foreground; above, a star.
durer-magos.caption: Albrecht Dürer, The Adoration of the Magi, from the series The Life of the Virgin, about 1502.

durer-nascimento-maria.title: The Birth of the Virgin
durer-nascimento-maria.alt: Black-and-white woodcut: an interior with a canopy bed where the mother rests; an angel flies beneath the arch, and women in the foreground care for the newborn.
durer-nascimento-maria.caption: Albrecht Dürer, The Birth of the Virgin, from the series The Life of the Virgin, about 1503.

durer-natividade.title: The Nativity
durer-natividade.alt: Black-and-white woodcut: a stable with a ruined roof, Mary kneeling before the Child, angels above and a star.
durer-natividade.caption: Albrecht Dürer, The Nativity, from the series The Life of the Virgin, 1502-3.

durer-pentecostes.title: Pentecost
durer-pentecostes.alt: Black-and-white woodcut: a dove radiates light above; below, apostles gathered, and in the center a seated veiled female figure with a book on her lap.
durer-pentecostes.caption: Albrecht Dürer, Pentecost, from the series The Small Passion, about 1510.

durer-porta-dourada.title: Joachim and Anne at the Golden Gate
durer-porta-dourada.alt: Black-and-white woodcut: beneath an ornate arch, a man and a woman in long mantles embrace; on the left, other figures look on; in the background, a wall and a landscape.
durer-porta-dourada.caption: Albrecht Dürer, Joachim and Anne at the Golden Gate, from the series The Life of the Virgin, about 1504.

durer-rejeicao-joaquim.title: The Rejection of Joachim's Offering
durer-rejeicao-joaquim.alt: Black-and-white woodcut: beneath a large arch, before curtains, priests and other people gathered around an altar table where an offering is made.
durer-rejeicao-joaquim.caption: Albrecht Dürer, The Rejection of Joachim's Offering, from the series The Life of the Virgin, about 1504.

durer-visitacao.title: The Visitation
durer-visitacao.alt: Black-and-white woodcut: two women embrace in front of a house, in a landscape of mountains and trees; a man watches from the door.
durer-visitacao.caption: Albrecht Dürer, The Visitation, from the series The Life of the Virgin, 1503-4.

obra-bellini-dormindo.title: Madonna Adoring the Sleeping Child
obra-bellini-dormindo.alt: Mary with joined hands, in a blue-grey mantle and light veil, beneath an arch with sky, contemplates the sleeping Christ Child before her.
obra-bellini-dormindo.caption: Giovanni Bellini, Madonna Adoring the Sleeping Child, early 1460s.

obra-bellini-madona.title: Madonna and Child
obra-bellini-madona.alt: Mary in a deep blue mantle and a light veil holds the naked Christ Child in front of a red cloth; on the left, a window opens onto a sky with clouds, mountains and a village.
obra-bellini-madona.caption: Giovanni Bellini, Madonna and Child, late 1480s.

obra-carnevale-nascimento.title: The Birth of the Virgin
obra-carnevale-nascimento.alt: Painting of classical architecture with columns and arches in shades of grey under a blue sky; women in blue and pink robes cross the floor in the foreground and, in the background, others care for a newborn.
obra-carnevale-nascimento.caption: Fra Carnevale, The Birth of the Virgin, 1467.

obra-david-crucificacao.title: The Crucifixion
obra-david-crucificacao.alt: Christ on the cross above a landscape with a distant city; on the left, Mary, in a light veil and dark mantle, and John; on the right, Saint Jerome and a kneeling female saint.
obra-david-crucificacao.caption: Gerard David, The Crucifixion, about 1495.

obra-david-descanso.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
obra-david-descanso.alt: Mary, in a blue mantle, seated on a knoll with the Child on her lap, under tall trees, before an open landscape with a city and a clear sky.
obra-david-descanso.caption: Gerard David, The Rest on the Flight into Egypt, about 1512-15.

obra-david-natividade.title: The Nativity
obra-david-natividade.alt: Mary and Joseph kneel in adoration before the Child lying on the ground, among ruins with arches opening onto a landscape; shepherds watch in the background.
obra-david-natividade.caption: Gerard David, The Nativity, early 1480s.

obra-david-virgem-paisagem.title: Virgin and Child
obra-david-virgem-paisagem.alt: Mary, with long hair and a dark mantle, holds the Child in a light tunic, before a landscape with trees, a lake and bluish mountains.
obra-david-virgem-paisagem.caption: Gerard David, Virgin and Child, about 1520.

obra-durer-virgem.title: Virgin and Child
obra-durer-virgem.alt: Mary, with tilted face and lowered eyes, in a red mantle, holds the naked Christ Child on her lap, against a dark background.
obra-durer-virgem.caption: Albrecht Dürer, Virgin and Child, 1516.

obra-flandes-cana.title: The Marriage at Cana
obra-flandes-cana.alt: Guests at a table covered in white in a hall with columns; Jesus and Mary, veiled, sit on the left, and a servant pours water from a jug beside the large stone jars.
obra-flandes-cana.caption: Juan de Flandes, The Marriage at Cana, about 1497.

obra-memling-anunciacao.title: The Annunciation
obra-memling-anunciacao.alt: The angel Gabriel, in gold-embroidered vestments, and Mary, in a blue mantle over a red dress, kneeling before a book, in a room with a red curtain and an open window.
obra-memling-anunciacao.caption: Hans Memling, The Annunciation, about 1465-70.

obra-pieta-alema.title: Pietà
obra-pieta-alema.alt: Polychrome sculpture: Mary, in a golden mantle and veil, seated, holds on her lap the body of the dead Christ, his head tilted back.
obra-pieta-alema.caption: Pietà, German sculpture in polychromed wood, 1435-40 (The Cloisters).

obra-ram-visitacao.title: The Visitation (panel from the altarpiece of Saint John)
obra-ram-visitacao.alt: Mary, in a blue mantle and golden halo, embraces and kisses Elizabeth, in a green mantle; beside them, a woman in pink and an old man in a golden tunic, in a courtyard with a pinkish floor.
obra-ram-visitacao.caption: Domingo Ram, The Visitation (panel from the altarpiece of Saint John), fifteenth century.

obra-raphael-entronizada.title: Madonna and Child Enthroned with Saints
obra-raphael-entronizada.alt: Mary enthroned with the Child, among saints, beneath a golden arch crowned by God the Father and angels, in an architectural frame on a grey background.
obra-raphael-entronizada.caption: Raphael, Madonna and Child Enthroned with Saints, about 1504.

obra-reni-imaculada.caption: Guido Reni, The Immaculate Conception, 1627.

obra-rosario-misterios.caption: Netherlandish painter (Brussels), The Fifteen Mysteries and the Virgin of the Rosary, about 1515-20.

obra-saraceni-dormicao.caption: Carlo Saraceni, The Dormition of the Virgin, about 1612.

obra-signorelli-assuncao.title: The Assumption of the Virgin with Saints Michael and Benedict
obra-signorelli-assuncao.alt: Mary enthroned on clouds, in a blue-grey mantle with hands joined, surrounded by musician angels; below, Saint Michael in armor, overcoming the devil, and Saint Benedict.
obra-signorelli-assuncao.caption: Luca Signorelli, The Assumption of the Virgin with Saints Michael and Benedict, about 1493-96.

retrato-akita.title: Our Lady of Akita Japan
retrato-akita.alt: Wooden sculpture of Mary before a cross, with arms open downward.
retrato-akita.caption: The statue of Our Lady of Akita (Japan).

retrato-altagracia.title: Imagen oficial de Nuestra Señora de la Altagracia.
retrato-altagracia.alt: Painting of Mary with joined hands, in a starry blue mantle and crown, before the Child lying down; Joseph appears in the background, on the left.
retrato-altagracia.caption: The image of Our Lady of Altagracia (Higüey, Dominican Republic).

retrato-antipolo.title: The Black Madonna image of Our Lady of Peace and Good Voyage, also known as Our Lady of Antipolo, enshrined at the Antip
retrato-antipolo.alt: Dark image of Mary with a richly embroidered mantle, crown and golden halo.
retrato-antipolo.caption: Our Lady of Peace and Good Voyage, in the cathedral of Antipolo (Philippines).

retrato-aparecida.title: Devoção à imagem, na Basílica do Santuário Nacional de Nossa Senhora da Conceição Aparecida.
retrato-aparecida.alt: Devotees pray before the golden niche holding the small dark image of Our Lady of Aparecida.
retrato-aparecida.caption: The image of Our Lady of Aparecida in the Basilica of the National Shrine, in Aparecida (Brazil).

retrato-banneux.title: The statue and source of Mary Virgin of the poor at Banneux
retrato-banneux.alt: Small white statue of Mary in a stone niche, above a spring, with flowers around.
retrato-banneux.caption: The statue of the Virgin of the Poor by the spring of Banneux (Belgium).

retrato-boa-saude-vailankanni.title: Our Lady of Vailankanni, a statue in the crypt of Basilique Notre-Dame de Fourvière, Lyon, France.
retrato-boa-saude-vailankanni.alt: Image of Mary with the Child, both with tall golden crowns, against a red background.
retrato-boa-saude-vailankanni.caption: Image of Our Lady of Vailankanni in the crypt of the Basilica of Fourvière, in Lyon (France). It is not the image of the Indian shrine.

retrato-cartago.title: Sculpture of the Virgen de los Ángeles in the Basilica of Our Lady of the Angels, Cartago, Costa Rica
retrato-cartago.alt: Small dark image of Mary with the Child, on a stone, with flowers beside it.
retrato-cartago.caption: The Virgin of the Angels, the “Negrita”, in the basilica of Cartago (Costa Rica).

retrato-covadonga.title: Imaxe de la Virxe de Cuadonga, la Santina, con mantu blancu.
retrato-covadonga.alt: Small image of Mary with the Child, in an embroidered white mantle and crown.
retrato-covadonga.caption: The Virgin of Covadonga, “la Santina”, in Asturias (Spain).

retrato-einsiedeln.title: Schwarze Madonna von Einsiedeln, mit Kind. Steht in der Klosterkirche von Einsiedeln in der Schweiz. Liegt an einem Weg
retrato-einsiedeln.alt: The chapel of grace, of black marble, inside the abbey church; in the center, the small dark image of Mary, with faithful seated in front.
retrato-einsiedeln.caption: The Black Madonna of Einsiedeln (Switzerland).

retrato-fatima.title: Fatima
retrato-fatima.alt: Statue of Mary dressed in white with golden edges, hands joined and a rosary hanging, beneath a crown.
retrato-fatima.caption: The first image of Our Lady of Fatima (Portugal).

retrato-guadalupe-mexico.title: Original Picture of Our Lady of Guadalupe (also known as the Virgin of Guadalupe) shown in the Basilica of Our Lady of G
retrato-guadalupe-mexico.alt: Mary standing on the moon, in a blue-green mantle covered with stars, hands joined and golden rays around her, held up by an angel.
retrato-guadalupe-mexico.caption: The image of Our Lady of Guadalupe venerated in the Basilica of Guadalupe, Mexico City.

retrato-harissa.title: Statue of Our Lady of Lebanon in Harissa, Lebanon.
retrato-harissa.alt: Great white statue of Mary with open arms on a pedestal, against the sky.
retrato-harissa.caption: The statue of Our Lady of Lebanon, in Harissa (Lebanon).

retrato-jasna-gora.title: Obraz Matki Bożej Częstochowskiej
retrato-jasna-gora.alt: Icon with a dark face: Mary holds the Child on her left arm and points to him; two scars mark her right cheek.
retrato-jasna-gora.caption: The icon of Our Lady of Częstochowa (Jasna Góra, Poland), without its cover.

retrato-kibeho.title: Ishusho ya Bikira Mariya Nyina wa Jambo, akaba kandi yitwa Mwamikazi wa Kibeho, iherereye mu cyanya cy'Ingoro ya Yezu Ny
retrato-kibeho.alt: Statue of Mary in a blue mantle and white robe, hands joined, on a pedestal inscribed “Kibeho”.
retrato-kibeho.caption: Image of Our Lady of Kibeho (“Nyina wa Jambo”, Mother of the Word), at the shrine of Ruhango (Rwanda). It is not the image from Kibeho.

retrato-la-salette.title: Statue de la Vierge de la Salette avec les enfants (détail), intérieur de l'église de Corps.
retrato-la-salette.alt: Statue of Mary with a crown of roses, a crucifix and a chain on her breast, before two children.
retrato-la-salette.caption: Statue of Our Lady of La Salette with the children, in the church of Corps (France).

retrato-lourdes.title: The grotto where St Bernadette's visions took place is very simple and stark. Above the main recess is the niche where t
retrato-lourdes.alt: White statue of Mary with a blue sash and joined hands, high in a niche in the rock of the grotto.
retrato-lourdes.caption: The statue of Our Lady in the niche of the grotto of Massabielle, in Lourdes (France).

retrato-lujan.title: Statue of Our Lady of Lujan in the Institute's seminary in the United States.
retrato-lujan.alt: Small image of Mary in a blue and white mantle with golden rays around her, on a pedestal.
retrato-lujan.caption: Replica of the image of Our Lady of Luján (Argentina), in a seminary in the United States. It is not the original image of the basilica.

retrato-manaoag.title: Our lady of Manaoag
retrato-manaoag.alt: Image of Mary in golden robes and crown, in a richly decorated niche with white flowers in front.
retrato-manaoag.caption: Our Lady of the Holy Rosary of Manaoag (Philippines).

retrato-mariazell.title: Gnadenstatue von Mariazell, "Magna Mater Austriae"
retrato-mariazell.alt: Small image of Mary in a red mantle, on a silver altar surrounded by golden columns.
retrato-mariazell.caption: The image of grace of Mariazell, “Magna Mater Austriae” (Austria).

retrato-montserrat.title: The Virgin of Montserrat
retrato-montserrat.alt: Sculpture of Mary with a dark face, seated, with the Child on her lap, both with crowns and golden robes.
retrato-montserrat.caption: The Virgin of Montserrat, the “Moreneta” (Catalonia, Spain).

retrato-nossa-senhora-da-china.title: An apparition of the Blessed Virgin Mary in Donglu, China, first appearing in 190
retrato-nossa-senhora-da-china.alt: Mary with the Child, both in Chinese imperial robes and crowns, in an old painting.
retrato-nossa-senhora-da-china.caption: Our Lady of China, in an image from about 1900, in imperial robes.

retrato-pompeia.title: Basilica di San Gennaro ad Antignano (Napoli) - Nella navata destra, sulla parete destra, in corrispondenza della 2° col
retrato-pompeia.alt: Painting of Mary enthroned with the Child, giving the rosary to Saint Dominic and Saint Catherine.
retrato-pompeia.caption: Copy of the painting of Our Lady of the Rosary of Pompeii, in the basilica of San Gennaro ad Antignano, in Naples. It is not the original from Pompeii.

retrato-santa-maria-maior.title: Salus Populi Romani icon after restoration, completed by the work of the Vatican Museum conservators in 2018.
retrato-santa-maria-maior.alt: Icon of Mary in a dark blue mantle with a golden border, holding the Child, who carries a book; golden background.
retrato-santa-maria-maior.caption: The Salus Populi Romani icon (Basilica of Saint Mary Major, Rome), after the restoration by the Vatican Museums completed in 2018.

retrato-suyapa.title: Artistic representation of the Virgin of Suyapa, Patron of Honduras and central America.
retrato-suyapa.alt: Drawing of the small image of Mary with joined hands, with mantle and halo.
retrato-suyapa.caption: Artistic representation of the Virgin of Suyapa (Honduras). It is not a photograph of the venerated image.

retrato-walsingham.title: The statue of Our Lady of Walsingham, the Slipper Chapel, Walsingham, Norfolk, England.
retrato-walsingham.alt: Crowned image of Mary with the Child, also crowned, and a spray of lilies.
retrato-walsingham.caption: The image of Our Lady of Walsingham in the Slipper Chapel (England).
